name: Named-Tool Handover
mechanism: Name a technique and give away its complete mechanic immediately so value arrives before the audience decides whether to stay.

caveats: five posts across three creators; post-level mapping is not retained here
short-video opening should not be treated as measured text transfer

adaptationNote: Use Muxin's own technique, example, and wording. The template supplies an information order, not a creator phrase.

name: State-and-Excuses Open
mechanism: Name the audience's current state and recite the excuses in their own order before closing the escape route.

caveats: two posts across two creators; neither post had a retrievable count
only one post carried the complete state-plus-excuses form

adaptationNote: Use only Muxin's supplied audience observation and point of view; do not import the source creator's list of excuses.

name: Found-Artifact Open
mechanism: Lead with work personally performed and one concrete discovery so the audience receives a finding rather than an unsupported opinion.

caveats: two posts from one creator; promising but not replicated across creators
engagement counts are not view counts

adaptationNote: Use Muxin's actual research, artifact, and interpretation. Preserve the distinction between finding and conclusion.

name: Refused Premise
mechanism: Reject a forced choice or received advice in the opening so the audience begins with a weight removed rather than another demand.

caveats: two posts across two creators; no view-count evidence on the platform

adaptationNote: Reject only a premise Muxin actually rejects. State her replacement view in her own language.

name: Counterfactual Snap
mechanism: Build a recognizable invented world, voice the rationalization inside it, then snap to the real subject in one short sentence.

caveats: largest clean multiple in the collected sample, but still n=1

adaptationNote: Invent no facts. Use a clearly marked hypothetical built from Muxin's supplied subject, then make the real-world pivot explicit.

name: Scope Tightener With the Unit Named
mechanism: Ask a factual question, rule out low-effort cases, and name the unit an answer should contain so responses become comparable.

caveats: platform-specific audience self-selection makes feed transfer untested

adaptationNote: Ask for the specific evidence or unit Muxin genuinely wants. Do not manufacture a metric request to inflate replies.

name: The Universal Opener
mechanism: Open on a blunt fact true of every reader, then narrow to the subject after the audience has been recruited.

caveats: spoken opening from short video; visual and edit treatment were not collected
short-video transfer to text is unmeasured

adaptationNote: Use a fact Muxin can defend and a real consequence. Do not borrow mortality language, examples, or cadence from the source.

name: The Outsider's Concession
mechanism: Address a group, admit holding the dismissal it is tired of hearing, explain why it seemed reasonable, then correct it plainly.

caveats: works only when Muxin is genuinely an outsider to the group's experience
do not reuse the source post's observed-behaviour list

adaptationNote: Use only where Muxin can honestly name her outsider position. The audience's experience and correction must come from her actual understanding.
